ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
